description: Held-out set for the jev criteria tuning. 24 cases written AFTER prompts/jev-v4.yaml was final, following the labelling convention of the reviewed golden set (locked out → account; malfunctioning feature incl. login/2FA/billing features → technical; price/discount question → billing; which-plan / what's-included → general; plan switch, invites, preferences → account). DRAFTED BY AI (Claude) on 2026-09-21 and NOT human-verified: it exists to check that the criteria did not only memorise the 80 tuning cases, not as ground truth.

cases.input: Your system charged my card $120 on Friday and again on Saturday for the same annual renewal. Please refund one of them.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged twice for the annual renewal and wants one charge refunded.

cases.input: I need the receipts for June, July and August in one PDF for my expense report.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants receipts for June to August combined into one PDF.

cases.input: Is there a nonprofit discount? We're a registered charity and the current price is hard to justify.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether a nonprofit discount exists because the current price is too high.

cases.input: You took payment for 20 seats. We agreed on 12 in writing with your rep. Fix the invoice and refund the difference.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was invoiced for 20 seats instead of the agreed 12 and wants a corrected invoice plus a refund.

cases.input: Love how the 'free' add-on turned into $30/month on my statement. Take it off and give me the money back.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was unexpectedly charged $30/month for an add-on and wants it removed and refunded.

cases.input: invoice for march?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks for the March invoice.

cases.input: The calendar sync with Google stopped working on Tuesday. Events created in your app no longer show up in Google Calendar.
cases.expected_summary: Google Calendar sync stopped on Tuesday; new events do not appear in Google Calendar.

cases.input: Uploading a 40 MB video fails at 99% with 'unknown error'. Smaller files are fine. Firefox on Windows 11.
cases.expected_summary: Uploads of a 40 MB video fail at 99% with an unknown error in Firefox on Windows 11.

cases.input: The 'Download invoice' button on the billing page does nothing when clicked. Console shows a 500 from /api/invoices/latest.
cases.expected_summary: The download-invoice button fails with a 500 error from the invoices API.

cases.input: Every time I enable two-factor, the app says 'setup complete' but next login it asks me to set it up again. Loop has happened four times.
cases.expected_summary: Two-factor setup does not persist; the app asks the customer to set it up again on every login.

cases.input: Merhaba, raporlar sayfası açılmıyor, sürekli 'yükleniyor' yazıyor. Dün çalışıyordu.
cases.expected_summary: The reports page never finishes loading; it worked yesterday.

cases.input: teh mobile app logs me out evry time i switch to anohter app and back. iphone 15, latest version
cases.expected_summary: The mobile app logs the customer out whenever they switch apps and return, on an iPhone 15.

cases.input: I reset my password an hour ago and the new one is rejected too. I need to get in before a client call at 2.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in even after a password reset and needs access before a 2 pm call.

cases.input: Please transfer ownership of the workspace to maria@northwind.example, I'm leaving the company on Friday.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants workspace ownership transferred to a colleague before leaving the company.

cases.input: We want to move from the Starter plan to Business next month — what do we need to do on our side?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to switch from the Starter plan to Business next month and asks how.

cases.input: Can you add a limit so members can't invite people outside our email domain?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to restrict invitations to their own email domain.

cases.input: The verification email for my new address hasn't arrived in two days. My old address still works but I need the change done.
cases.expected_summary: The email-change verification message has not arrived for two days and the customer needs the change completed.

cases.input: stop sending me product update emails
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants product update emails turned off.

cases.input: Does your API have an official Go client, or should we generate one from the OpenAPI spec?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether an official Go client exists for the API.

cases.input: Which plan includes audit logs? Starter, Team or Business?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks which plan includes audit logs.

cases.input: Is there an outage right now? Our whole team sees slowness but I don't see anything on the status page.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether there is an outage because their team sees slowness and the status page shows nothing.

cases.input: Would you add the ability to schedule reports to be emailed weekly? Our managers keep asking.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests scheduled weekly report emails.

cases.input: Delightful new pricing page. Truly a puzzle. Which of the five tiers is the one for a team of three?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks which pricing tier suits a three-person team, sarcastically complaining about the pricing page.

cases.input: thanks, all sorted now
cases.expected_summary: Customer says their issue is resolved and thanks the team.
